notes.detail: Inside is furnished (hearth furnace, slab table and stair chair, barrels, chest, 3 beds, torches), but the outside is bare: no shutters, sills, lanterns or planters until L2.
notes.depth: Ground floor has posts, a cobble plinth and the front jetty on brackets, but both long sides of the upper storey are a flat band of white terracotta between two log beams with no window or break.
notes.roof: 45 degrees, 1-block overhang all round, dark oak ridge and eave course, top-stair gable trim. The bottom dark oak stair beside the top spruce stair at the gable corners (x1/x7, y6, z0 and z8) curls the eave a little, acceptable.
notes.shape: Front jetty, side brick chimney with a stepped base, roof overhangs: not a plain box, though it reads boxy from the sides.
notes.life: Only one mossy cobblestone; no plants, lanterns or path. Expected for the shell level.
notes.scale: 5 x 6 ground floor, walls 3 high, two storeys: right for a narrow townhouse.

visual.summary: The shell: stone-brick ground floor on a cobble plinth with a furnished kitchen-living room and staircase, a jettied dark oak and plaster upper storey with 3 beds, spruce roof and a brick chimney.
problems: Upper storey long sides (x2 and x6, y5, z1..z7) are blank white terracotta with no windows: the bedroom has light only through the gable panes at y6; add a window or a post to break each side.
Reachability: 93 of 131 standing places reached; the unreached ones are roof slopes, the chimney top and a barrel top. Both floors and the staircase are reached, so this is fine.
